answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade, and tie that stake to one verifiable work history: each completed job leaves a signed record, like a quill mark, that cannot be copied to a new identity. A newcomer must therefore earn trust slowly, while a fake swarm must fund each identity and repeat the work. One bad act burns the stake and sends a ripple through its history, so the attacker pays in both money and time; a zephyr of cheap new names cannot outrun that cost.
